subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr ripped the chain from the warlock's hands during the fight.
source_quote: Zephyr managed to rip the chain from the warlock's hands during the fight.

subject: Warlock
fact: The warlock had the Potion of Fire Resistance on his person but panicked and never reached for it during the chaos of the chimera's rampage.
source_quote: The warlock had it on his person but panicked and never reached for it during the chaos of the chimera's rampage.

subject: Warlock
fact: The warlock used Eldritch Blast at Sequioa, dealing significant damage early in the fight.
source_quote: Beams of crackling energy fired by the Fire Temple warlock at Sequioa, dealing significant damage early in the fight.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer used Healing Word to restore Sequioa to consciousness.
source_quote: A quick divine incantation used by Calmer on two separate occasions during the battle — first to restore Sequioa to consciousness, and later to bring Zephyr back from the brink of death.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer used Healing Word to bring Zephyr back from the brink of death.
source_quote: A quick divine incantation used by Calmer on two separate occasions during the battle — first to restore Sequioa to consciousness, and later to bring Zephyr back from the brink of death.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer cast Toll the Dead, which manifested as the sound of a melancholy tolling bell, and delivered the final, fatal blow to the wounded Chimera.
source_quote: A necrotic spell cast by Calmer that manifests as the sound of a melancholy tolling bell. It was used multiple times during the fight and ultimately delivered the final, fatal blow to the wounded Chimera.

subject: Nulb's River Pirates
fact: The chains were stamped with the marks of Nulb's River Pirates, revealing that someone in Nulb was paid to deliver the monster, but the identity of the payer is not specified in this session.
source_quote: The chains were later found to be stamped with the marks of Nulb's River Pirates, revealing that someone in Nulb was paid to deliver the monster.

subject: Vesrek
fact: The warlock's ledger revealed a connection to Vesrek, an ally of the Water Temple's prophet Belsornig, but the nature of that connection is not specified in this session.
source_quote: It also revealed a connection to Vesrek, an ally of the Water Temple's prophet Belsornig.

subject: Warlock
fact: The warlock possessed a heavy gold amulet and chain depicting the eight-pointed symbol of the Fire Temple, worth 100 gold pieces.
source_quote: A heavy gold amulet and chain depicting the eight-pointed symbol of the Fire Temple, found on the warlock. Its craftsmanship and gold weight make it worth 100 gold pieces.

subject: Warlock
fact: The warlock possessed a high-quality whip woven with alchemically treated red leather, featuring a ten-foot reach and capable of slowing an enemy's movement.
source_quote: A high-quality whip woven with alchemically treated red leather, found among the warlock's belongings. While not magical, it is of fine craftsmanship, features a ten-foot reach, and can slow an enemy's movement.

subject: Warlock
fact: The warlock possessed a magical elixir intended to protect the user from heat and flames.
source_quote: A magical elixir found on the warlock, intended to protect the user from heat and flames.

subject: Warlock
fact: The warlock held a heavy wax-sealed receipt bearing the crest of a crimson ship, a bill of sale from Captain Varsik of the Crimson Trader detailing the purchase of the chimera, paid in full by the Fire Temple.
source_quote: A document found on the Fire Temple warlock, containing a heavy wax-sealed receipt bearing the crest of a crimson ship. It is a bill of sale from Captain Varsik of the Crimson Trader detailing the purchase of the chimera, paid in full by the Fire Temple.
